name: Redshift to Pinterest Ads Audiences
steps:
**1\. Setup a Data Warehouse** - Go to [Data Warehouses](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) Tab and add a Redshift Warehouse. 

*\*To understand how to add a Redshift Data Warehouse check out this* [*video*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZH8IfbBMqts&t=3s)*.*

**2\. Setup a Data Model** - Navigate to [Data Models](https://console.datachannel.co/data-models) tab and click on [Create New](https://console.datachannel.co/data-models/add). Name your Data Model and select your data warehouse from the drop down. Write a SQL query to fetch data from your warehouse. 

(Eg. *Select* \* *from* ***Schema\_Name***.***Table\_Name***)

*\*A simple “select” statement will work, although you can write complex SQL queries in the data model field itself or use our no-code segment builder to filter your data without writing complex SQL Queries.*

**3\. Configure your Data Destination** - Navigate to [Destinations](https://console.datachannel.co/reverse-connectors) tab and select Pinterest Ads.

-   Add Your Credentials using the “[+](https://api.datachannel.co/datasources/pinterest/credentials/add?token=eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6IjVhNTA5ZjAxOWY3MGQ3NzlkODBmMTUyZDFhNWQzMzgxMWFiN2NlZjciLCJ0eXAiOiJKV1QifQ..lJvZRB3zMI31oNHx9eVn4G9msaoodXcfrNJbl3w5Ca6QP06gZ3lBPiQEx5gFMyA0MGClbFWLGLxbo85i3c6-mpGR4eSwUXrKIjSKRvKr4tVCTUSUeupPslpBkrs6pKo5YrFhZiMzGW7tgOVdlxB0U-CeetYXXNSM7eF34wMjhJPMfaswOUM5Xu1-gbPDFnmiB1iQSKpgjnQFB8scNbj-kb3FW7zCTNRHkNprXwfhYTM0F7XakXSpQFV9zMcnRNKzrMeh8LfsyzWCCsz9obf3RxMVOd7TSCEfUqZsX2u7PwtYF70o3gKeSrCqyZy4orxCil15kt0DHSvmj3lqPQqCzg)” Button. You will easily be able to sign up using OAuth.
